component.name: Sticky
component.summary: Sticky notes with a KDE-style look

description.p: Sticky notes on the desktop, with groups, a manager window, formatting, checklists, backups and a tray icon. Linux Mint's Sticky, changed to fit a KDE Plasma desktop: notes with rounded corners like Breeze windows, a manager with the KWin title bar, a toolbar like the KDE applications, softer note colors and freedesktop icon names.
